title: Anonymous ('MR') to the duc de Mercœur, 26 June [c. 1586], BnF fr. 15564 f. 151 (catalogue item 13)

steps.what: Grepped cryptiana GL.htm and unsolved.htm: Lasry solved ff. 27/78/119/142 and judged f. 151 a different key, too short.
Located f. 151 as the slip on Gallica view 164 and fetched full-resolution crops.
Compared the sign set with Lasry's fr. 15564 key: no shared signs.
Compared with Mayenne–Forget Cipher-1 (matignon1586) and the Clairambault 357 figure cipher.
Transcribed the six cipher runs (217 signs, 55 types) and the clear frame.
Homophonic simulated annealing, 4-gram French LM, 8 restarts.
Same solver on shuffled ciphertext scored as well (-1.82 vs -1.87 per sign): no signal.

outcome.method_basis: The 217 cipher signs were transcribed but not read: Lasry's fr. 15564 key and two other 1586 League keys share no signs with it, and a homophonic annealer scored no better than on shuffled text.
outcome.notes: Clear frame transcribed; cipher too short for ciphertext-only attack; needs a sibling letter or key.

prior.where: Lasry found it did not decipher with his fr. 15564 key (reported by Tomokiyo, unsolved.htm)

human: Project-level: set up Claude Code with Opus 5 and posed the catalogue entry with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.
